    Build Data Matrices for the Taylor Rule State-Space Model

    build_data_matrix_taylor.Rd

    Constructs and aligns the observation and exogenous regressor time series required for estimating the Taylor rule state-space model at a given forecast origin. Supports configurable Taylor rule specifications (backward-looking vs. forward-looking) and flexible inflation gap definitions.

    build_data_matrix_taylor(
  T_0 = "1981-01-01",
  vantage_quarter,
  data = master_taylor,
  gdp_forecasts = gdp_forecasts_arima,
  h = h,
  set_silent = TRUE,
  quarterly = TRUE,
  taylor_rule_spec = "backward",
  if_gap_spec = "minus_1"
)

    Arguments

    T_0

    Character, Date, or yearqtr. Start date of the estimation window. Defaults to "1981-01-01".

    vantage_quarter

    Character, Date, or yearqtr. The real-time forecast origin/vintage date.

    data

    A data frame containing quarterly series (quarter, log_cpi, saron_libor_splice, forward_rate, yoy_inf, inf_gap). Defaults to master_taylor.

    gdp_forecasts

    A data frame containing real-time GDP forecast vintages. Defaults to gdp_forecasts_arima.

    h

    Integer. Forecast horizon in quarters. Defaults to h.

    set_silent

    Logical. If TRUE, suppresses informational console messages. Defaults to TRUE.

    quarterly

    Logical. Frequency flag for quarterly tracking. Defaults to TRUE.

    taylor_rule_spec

    Character string specifying the policy rule formulation: "backward" (realized/lagged macro variables) or "forward" (forecast/survey expectations). Defaults to "backward".

    if_gap_spec

    Character string defining the inflation gap construction: "minus_1" (deviations from a 1% target benchmark) or "ssm_gap" (deviations from latent trend estimates). Defaults to "minus_1".

    Value

    A data frame aligned over [T_0, vantage_quarter] containing:

    quarter

    Quarterly dates of class yearqtr.

    saron_libor_splice

    Policy interest rate splice series.

    forward_rate

    Long-term forward rate expectations proxy.

    yoy_inf

    Year-on-Year realized inflation rate.

    gdp_gap

    Real-time cyclical HP output gap (\(\times 100\)).

    inf_gap

    Configured inflation gap series.

    See also

    get_hp_gap, rolling_est_taylor_ssm, initialize_taylor_ssm
